steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 200 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Kielce is worth 110; I offer 200 cash so you can grab more property.

reply.message: Giving away a full set for 200 fl is too cheap; I'll keep Kielce.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 300 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Raised offer: 300 fl for Kielce, nearly triple its price.

reply.message: Handing over the last Polder street would give you a full set. I'll keep Kielce.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen, 100 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Groningen (160) plus 100 fl for Kielce (110). Groningen puts you one step from Tulp alongside your Lublin.

reply.message: Giving P0 the Polder full set isn't worth it; I'll keep Kielce.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Groningen; haiku-5.5 gives Radom, 60 fl
steps.message: Groningen completes nothing for me but pairs with your Toruń toward Tulp. I'd take Radom plus 60 fl.

reply.message: Fair enough. Groningen pairs with my Toruń and I'm happy to give up Radom plus 60 fl.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Radom, 150 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Radom plus 150 fl for Kielce: 230 fl of value for a 110 street. You can also chase Lelystad for Klei.

reply.message: Handing over the Polder full set isn't worth it; Kielce stays with me.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Radom, 250 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Final big offer: Radom plus 250 fl for Kielce. That's 330 fl of value for a 110 street, cash you can use on Kaas or Las.

reply.message: Kielce stays with me; I won't hand over the Polder full set.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 200 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag
steps.message: 200 fl for Den Haag. That's 120 over its price, and it completes nothing for you while Kraków is still unowned.

steps.terms: haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag; opus-5.5 gives 450 fl
steps.message: Den Haag is the only Las street I hold and it blocks your Las full set. I'd sell for 450 fl cash, not 200.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 280 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag
steps.message: 450 is nearly all my cash for a street that still doesn't complete anything. 280 fl is a solid premium over its 320 value-to-you as a lone Las card.

steps.terms: haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag; opus-5.5 gives 370 fl
steps.message: 280 is below what I paid. I'll sell Den Haag for 370 fl cash.

reply.message: 370 would leave me nearly cashless for a set that still isn't complete. Maybe later.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives 320 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag
steps.message: 320 fl cash for Den Haag, full price. It's a lone Las card for you and the cash helps you build.

reply.message: Den Haag stays with me. It's my Las anchor and I'm not selling below its value.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 150 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Wodociągi Wisła plus 150 fl for Kielce. Combined with nothing else it gives you utility income, and the cash helps you on Kaas.

reply.message: Kielce stays with me; I won't hand over the Polder full set.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Radom, 200 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: Radom plus 200 fl for Kielce. That is well over Kielce's price, and the cash funds houses on your Kaas or Tulp ambitions.
promises: I will not build more than 3 houses on Polder for 5 rounds

reply.message: Kielce stays with me; handing over the Polder full set is not worth it.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 230 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag
steps.message: Wodociągi Wisła plus 230 fl for Den Haag. That is 370 in total value, the price you asked for in R10, and the utility earns you steady rent.

steps.terms: haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag; opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 300 fl
steps.message: Den Haag is my only Las street and it blocks your Las set. I'll take Wodociągi Wisła plus 300 fl cash.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 260 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag
steps.message: Let's meet in the middle: Wodociągi Wisła plus 260 fl for Den Haag. That's 400 in value for a 320 street.

steps.terms: haiku-5.5 gives Den Haag; opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 330 fl
steps.message: Den Haag is my only Las street and it blocks your Las set. I'll take Wodociągi Wisła plus 330 fl cash, or we keep the status quo.

reply.message: 470 in value for a 320 street with Kraków still unowned is too steep. Status quo for now.

steps.terms: heuristic gives Haarlem; haiku-5.5 gives Eindhoven, 140 fl

reply.message: Haarlem completes my Cegła set, and I'm happy to give up Eindhoven.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 60 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: You're low on cash at 26 fl. Wodociągi Wisła plus 60 fl for Kielce gives you money now and steady utility income after.

reply.message: Kielce stays with me; not handing over the Polder full set for a utility and 60 fl.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 100 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: You're at 68 fl and in jail. Wodociągi Wisła plus 100 fl for Kielce gives you a cash cushion plus utility income.
promises: I will not build more than 3 houses on Polder for 5 rounds

reply.message: Kielce stays with me; the Polder full set is not for sale at this price.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 150 fl; sonnet-5.5 gives Kielce
steps.message: You have 8 fl. 150 fl plus Wodociągi Wisła for Kielce keeps you in the game.

reply.message: Kielce stays with me; the Polder full set is not for sale at this price.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Wodociągi Wisła, 120 fl; heuristic gives Kielce
steps.message: Kielce alone earns you 8 fl. Wodociągi Wisła pairs with your Windpark for 12x dice rent, plus 120 fl cash now.

steps.terms: opus-5.5 gives Rotterdam; haiku-5.5 gives 120 fl
steps.message: Rotterdam brings you to 2 of 3 Las, with Kraków still unowned. 120 fl covers the mortgage value, and lifting it costs you only 10% extra.

reply.message: Deal. Rotterdam at 120 fl is a fair price for a 350 street that brings me to 2 of 3 Las.

steps.terms: heuristic gives Lublin, 70 fl; haiku-5.5 gives Emmen, Apeldoorn
haiku-5.5 gives Emmen; heuristic gives Lublin, 70 fl
steps.message: Emmen alone for Lublin plus 70 fl. Apeldoorn stays with me, so no Polder full set for either of us.

steps.terms: heuristic gives Lublin; haiku-5.5 gives Emmen, 420 fl

reply.message: Emmen plus 420 fl for a mortgaged Lublin is far too much. I'm out at this price.

reasoning.text: Cheap property early in the game, and it starts building toward the Polder group, which is inexpensive to develop.
Early game with plenty of cash; buying Kielce is cheap and blocks P0's Polder full set while giving trade leverage.
Toruń is a Tulp group property at a fair price with cash to spare; owning color groups enables building and doubled rent.
Amsterdam is the top-rent property, I have plenty of cash early on, and owning it blocks the Wisła group for opponents.
Plenty of cash early in the game; Lublin is a reasonable property and buying it blocks P2's Tulp full set while giving me trade leverage.
Łódź starts a full color group (Cegła) with strong rents once built out, and I have ample cash to fund houses. Buying early secures the group.
Radom is a cheap Klei property with 1310 fl cash, so buying is affordable and starts a color group that can be developed later.
Buying Apeldoorn gives me 2 of the 3 Polder streets, which blocks P1 from the group and gives me trade leverage for Kielce. It is cheap and I have plenty of cash.
Completing Polder lets me build cheap houses early.
Completing P0's Polder set lets them build and gain a big advantage, and 200 fl doesn't compensate for that.
No useful management actions now; mortgaging only loses income and I have ample cash.
Szczecin completes a potential Cegła group with my Łódź, and I have ample cash (1234) to afford it. Owning color groups enables house building and doubled rent.
Groningen blocks the Tulp group and gives me something to trade for Kielce. Cash is ample.
Completing Polder enables cheap, high-return houses; I'm raising the cash offer to P1 for Kielce.
Giving P0 a full set for 300 fl strengthens a rival and is not worth it; Kielce blocks their set.
No need to mortgage with 1206 cash; keep properties and hold Kielce to block P0's Polder full set.
I have 1131 fl in cash, so I don't need to mortgage anything. Mortgaging would cost rent income and gain nothing now.
It's early in the game and I have plenty of cash, so a utility at 140 adds steady income and gives me trade leverage. That still leaves 733 fl for later decisions.
Polder is a cheap full set worth chasing, and Groningen gives P1 strategic value in Tulp in return.
Accepting hands P0 a complete Polder set that they can build on. Groningen plus 100 fl doesn't compensate for that, and I would still need Toruń from P2 to complete Tulp.
Many properties are still unowned, so getting back on the board quickly to buy them is worth 50 fl, and I have plenty of cash.
No need to mortgage with 1139 cash; keep properties and avoid giving away full sets.
I have 1119 cash and no full set-building options among the listed actions; mortgaging would only lose rent income and offers no benefit now, so I hold all properties and do nothing this turn.
A station gives steady income and possible trade leverage, and paying 180 leaves a comfortable 582 fl cash.
P1 refuses Kielce, so I am trying a different trade for a little value; no management actions are needed.
There is no reason to mortgage anything, since I have enough cash and no full set to build on. I will keep my properties earning rent.
Groningen (price 160, Tulp) is worth more than Radom (80) plus 60 fl, and it strengthens my Tulp holdings while denying P0 that color group.
I have 1139 fl, so 310 is affordable. Wrocław is the first Kaas street, and the other two are unowned, so I could build toward a full set.
No need to mortgage anything with 829 cash on hand; keep properties and cash.
Stations are cheap to hold and collect rent across the station group; I have ample cash (1259) to afford the 180 fl price and keep a healthy reserve.
I have 1079 cash, so there is no need to mortgage, and none of the listed options improve my position. I'll keep my properties and hold cash.
I keep pursuing the Polder full set with a stronger offer, and I avoid mortgaging anything.
Accepting would give P0 a complete Polder set, which is low-value but would still strengthen a rival, and Radom plus cash doesn't change my position enough.
I have 800 cash and no need to mortgage anything, and no trade clearly helps me right now.
Eindhoven is a solid Bursztyn property with 1130 fl cash available, and it lets me pursue the Bursztyn group alongside Maastricht while my cash position remains strong.
